Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Mr. Deepak Kumar, petitioner￾in-person.
Mr. G.S. Negi, Additional CSC, 
for the State. 
Mr. Shailendra Nauriyal, 
Advocate, for the selecting body. 
(2) Petitioner-in-person contends 
that benefit of Government Orders dated 
8.1.2021 and 20.12.2021 is not being 
given by Uttarakhand Subordinate 
Service Selection Commission to Ex￾Servicemen in the selection held for 
different Group ‘C’ posts, while 
Uttarakhand Public Service Commission 
has relaxed the cut-off marks in favour 
of Ex-Servicemen. He refers to page 134 
of the writ petition in support of his 
contention that the last selected 
candidate belonging to Ex-Servicemen 
category scored 14.6478 per cent marks 
only. Thus he submits that different 
selecting bodies within the State of 
Uttarakhand are adopting different 
yardsticks. While Uttarakhand Public 
Service Commission is following the 
government policy, whereas Uttarakhand 
Subordinate Service Selection 
Commission has not followed the 
government policy in the selection for 
the post of Forester. 
(3) Learned State Counsel as well  as Mr. Shailendra Nauriyal, appearing for 
UKSSSC, shall get clear instructions on 
the aforesaid aspect by 14.4.2026.
(4) List on 15.4.2026 under the 
same caption. 
 (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.)
 8.4.2026
